page.metaDescription: Fullstack CV. Node.js, TypeScript, React, APIs, data modeling, MySQL/PostgreSQL/MongoDB/Redis/Couchbase, Tailwind CSS, responsive UI, dashboards.
page.titleTagline: Fullstack · Node.js · TypeScript · React · Architecture · Data Systems
page.summary: Software engineer with 20+ years of programming experience and 10+ years of production Node.js development (since early 0.10 versions). Designed and implemented backend systems using Node.js and TypeScript, with strong emphasis on modular architecture, data modeling and maintainable service design. Experienced in evolving legacy systems and modernizing architecture across different stages of the JavaScript ecosystem. Also worked on practical frontend development, including internal dashboards, responsive UI and frontend-backend integration.
